title: Three rates on one median house
subtitle: Annual Central Health tax bill on a Travis County homestead valued at $372,638
source: Central Health budget figures, via KVUE
alt: Bar chart of the annual Central Health property tax bill on a median Travis County homestead valued at $372,638 under three rates the district is weighing for fiscal year 2027: about $470 at the no-new-revenue rate, about $496 at a 6 percent increase, and about $504 at the 8 percent increase the board set as its maximum
